balls.text: Pace off and there is a run out. Slower back of a length ball, Jadeja pulls to deep midwicket. Mitchell hares back for a second, but Jadeja isn't going anywhere. Saha casually whips off the bails and Jadeja is deemed out after the TV umpire has a look
Squirted past short third. Very full just outside off. He backs away, gets his bat down, and the edge just goes past Johnson.
Slower offcutter on middle. Jadeja gets aross and scoops him past short fine leg. Does not get the right kind of connection but enough for two. CSK reach 200.
Straight down long-on's throat! On-pace full ball on off stump. He gets under it, and looks to go over long-on. Gets it off the bottom of the bat with Miller making no mistake.
Slower back of a length ball on middle. Rizvi gets inside the line and looks to go over fine leg. Gets totally beaten
Fuller in length outside off, he slams it to long off
SHOT! Rizvi has taken down Rashid for two sixes. These kids have no fear. Jumps down the track to the flatter length ball, does not get a clean connection, but enough to clear long off
Big wind up but does not connect. Leggie outside off, he looks to go across the line, but misses. Lost his shape a touch there
Short and wide, he cuts it to deep point for a couple of runs
Oh, hello! What a shot first ball in the IPL. Fuller down leg, he gets down on one knee and sweeps him hard over deep backward square leg

Mistimed and Rashid gets his man! Googly right across Dube and away from his arc outside off. Was at the tramline. Dube looks to go after him, gets it right of the bottom of blade as the ball balloons straight up for extra cover to take a simple catch
Flatter outside off, he winds up looking for a big six down the ground. Instead gets a thick outside edge to short third
Fifty for Dube off 22 balls! He has provided the impetus that CSK really needed. Seventh IPL fifty. Gets it with a pull to deep square leg for a couple of runs.

Back of a hand slower ball outside off. Was a back of a length ball. Dube thinks that is past the tramline and lets it go. The umpire reckons it is a wide. Dube reviews. That was inside tramline. So, CSK lose a review
Fuller outside off, he looks to go over long-off, but does not get a decent connection. The ball goes to long-off on the bounce
On pace back of a length ball on middle, he swivels and mistimes the pull to deep midwicket
Back of a hand slower ball but Dube has picked it up nice and early. Was fuller outside off, Dube waits for it and hammers him deep over long off
Full and very wide outside off, Mitchell can only drag it to long-on
Slower length ball on middle and leg at 123.6kph. He shuffles across and taps it to deep midwicket
Oh, shot! Lovely innovation there. Low full toss just outside off. He gets across, and gets the scoop out executing it perfectly over short fine leg
Big swing and a miss! That was in the slot outside. Mitchell sees it up and winds up big time. Loses his shape, and can't make a connection.
back of a length ball outside off, he slaps it hard but Gill does really well to his left at mid-off
Pinpoint yorker on middle stump, he digs it out to the bowler. That chips the bottom of Dube's bat.
Pacy back of a length ball at 139.5kph on middle. Mitchell mistimes his pull to long on
Good end to the over for Dube. Slower back of a length ball on leg stump. He just gets inside the line and helps it to the fine leg fence. Nothing deep backward square leg could have done there
Length ball outside off, he hammers the drive but straight to long off, who is a touch square
Slower bouncer on off and middle stump. Mitchell heaves it away in the gap to the right of deep midwicket. Rashid does well to keep them down to two
Good delivery. On-pace yorker on off stump. Mitchell can only dig it as far as wide long-on
Misses out there does Mitchell. Slower length ball down leg. He helps it but straight to short fine leg
Slower bouncer to start off just outside off. Dube waits for it and pulls to deep backward square leg
Length ball down leg, he clips to fine leg as CSK collect 14 off the 16th over.
Who says Dube is susceptible to the bouncer?  Banged in short, shoulder-high. He gets across, slightly inside the line and pulls over deep fine leg and into the crowd. What a connection
Whisked past fine leg! That is a lovely stroke from Dube. Not the right line from Johnson. Back of a length ball on his hips and down leg. He whips it to the right of fine leg
Another back of a length ball on middle, he gets his front leg out of the way but can only miscue his pull to deep midwicket
Banged in short on off, he mistimes his pull to long-on
Pacy back of a length ball on off. Mitchell looks for a pull, is late on the pull and hit smack in the midriff. They steal a legbye
Going, going, gone! Was the googly outside off, but doesn't make a difference. Dube bends down on one knee, gets under the ball, and deposits him miles over long-on
Fuller and well down leg, would have been called a wide had he touched that. He whisks it away to deep midwicket
Now connects with the reverse cleanly and gets four. Flatter outside off, he waits for the ball and slaps the reverse past backward point
Leg break on leg stump, he flicks it to the right of deep midwicket. Mitchell was looking for a second but was not on
Wrong'un on off stump, he gets forward and pushes to long-on
Goes reverse first ball to the length ball outside off. Can't beat backward point
Sharp good length ball just outside off, he gets an under-edge to short third. Is livid with himself for not getting more bat on that
Fuller in length on the stumps, he drives to mid-on and takes off
Length ball outside off, he pushes to cover and sets off only to be sent back by Dube

Huge appeal for caught behind  and the umpire has given it. Gaikwad is walking off as well. Back of a length ball angling across the batter, who looks for a pull, gets an inside edge with the ball going to the keeper. That's a rather important wicket
On a length outside off stump, Gaikwad drives on the up but can't beat extra cover. Didn't get enough timing on it.
Back of a length ball on off, he swats it away to long-on
Fuller in length just outside off, he drives to mid-off and sets off for a quick run
Backs away but Mohit, the experienced bowler he is, follows Gaikwad outside leg at pace. The batter can only mistime him to long-off
Another bouncer with the line just outside off, and shoulder high. Dube mistimes his pull towards deep midwicket
Bouncer but the line is just down leg, and that is a late call of a wide. The umpire suggests the ball was down leg.
On a length on middle and leg, he eases it to long-on
Back of a length ball outside off, he slashes it to deep third for a run
Length ball on off, he ticks it to deep midwicket first up

Leading edge, but over extra cover's head. Gaikwad shimmies down the track to the length ball and was looking to work it away to the on-side. Closed the face of the bat early, and thankfully for him the ball does not go to hand
Fuller in length on middle, he pushes towards the bowler, who does well in his follow-through
Fuller on the middle stump, he can only dig it to the on-side
Flatter well outside off, just past the tramline. Called a wide.
Makes no difference. TWO IN TWO! Slower through the air on middle and leg. He gets down on one knee again and absolutely pummels him deeeeep over midwicket.
And he gets going first ball! In the slot outside off, he bends down on one knee, and pumps him over long-on. What a start for Dube

Sai Kishore gets his man. The Chennai boy strikes at home. Was pushed quicker on middle, and that turned just a little bit as well. Rahane jumps down looking to go across the line. Misses, and Saha does the rest.
Oh, shot sir! Length ball on middle, Gaikwad, steps away and nonchalantly lofts it over the bowler's head. The ball just bounces inside the rope
Now rushes Rahane with that sharp short ball. Banged in short down leg, he gets rapped on the gloves looking for a pull with the ball going to deep third. The 100 is up as well.
Length ball outside off, he prods forward and drives to mid-off for a quick run
Sharp back of a length ball outside off. Gaikwad is slightly late on the pull that goes to mid-on
Gets beaten now. Angles the length ball outside, he looks to dab it to deep third, makes no connection
Pulled and over deep midwicket! What a welcome for Johnson. Short ball just below the shoulders on off. Gaikwad pulls and gets a good chunk of it to clear the fielder
Angled in on the stumps, he whips it to deep backward square leg
Slower through the air, gets a bit of turn as well just outside off. But Gaikwad is so quick to go back and thrash the cut to the left of deep cover
Ah, misses out. Short, wide, he cuts but can't beat point
Slower through the air on off, pushed to on side

Full on middle and leg as he clips to long on. Hang on, what's happened there. Miller was running in from long on, Vijay Shankar from deep midwicket, and both left it for each other. The result: three extra runs
Angled in on a length just on off, he pushes with an open face but straight to cover point
Short and slightly wide again, he stays back and cuts past point
Wrong'un on off stump. But the length was slightly short and there was enough time for Gaikwad to hop back and slam the pull to deep midwicket
Stifle short outside off, he stays back and pats it to long on
Jumps down the track trying to reach the pitch of the ball as he drives to extra cover. A slight misfield and they take a run
up and over! Tossed up outside off. He bends low, and lofts him neatly over extra cover. That is a lovely chip shot
Cut past point for a couple of runs. Short and wide, he rocks back and gets two.
Flatter in length on middle and leg stump, he whisks it away to long on off the back foot
On a length around 85.9kph on off, he pushes to extra cover
Darted quick but down leg. Called a wide
Swept neatly but there is Spencer is around that deep backward square leg region. Fuller down leg, he gets a good chunk on that but not enough to beat the fielder
Fuller on off, he drives to extra cover
Gaikwad looks to give himself room, but Sai Kishore sees that and follows him. Fuller in length. Gaikwad pushes to long off
Flatter length ball on the pads. He clips to deep backward square leg first up
Oh, that's a top shot. All timing there. Was just short on off, he rocks back and pushes past cover. He just had to find the gap. Once that happened, it was four for the taking
Fuller on middle and leg, he works it through midwicket
Slightly short on off, he eases it to long on off the backfoot
Flatter outside off, he pats it to cover, who makes an excellent diving stop. Rahane is away though

Oh, is Rachin stumped there? His reaction and Saha's reaction seems to suggest so. Oh, yeah, he is gone. Was a quicker length ball on leg stump, he gets a thick inside edge through his leg. Don't think Rachin knew how far or where exactly the ball went and ventured out of his crease. Saha was quick to whip off the bails to finds Rachin short
Slightly short on middle stump, he goes back and hacks it past mid-off to start off
Length ball outside off, he was looking to thrash this through covers again. Ends up mistiming towards mid-off and still takes a run
Bouncer attempted but the line is well outside off. Called a wide
Slower back of a length ball outside off. Rachin gets his front leg outside the line of leg, and slaps him past mid-off with disdain.
Good riposte. Banged in short aiming for his body. Rachin is late on his pull.

TAKE THAT! Good length ball outside off. He transfers his weight, then extends his arms and absolutely smokes him miles over long-on. What power, what timing from this 24-year-old. The fifty is up as well in the fifth over
Rapped on the pads, but think that was going down leg. Length on middle and leg, they pinch in a leg-bye
CREAMED! Such a teaser for the fielder that one. On the slot outside off, Gaikwad leans forward and drives with elan to the right of mid-off. Gill gives chase but can't do much, not on this outfield.
Sharp bouncer to end the over. Rachin sways away from the line of that
Length outside off, he pushes towards point and sets off. Rachin responds well

There's power at the one end, there's deft touch at the other. Good length ball outside off. Gaikwad waits for the ball and opens the face of the bat to guide past short third. Deep point puts in a sprawling dive, but can't rein the ball in
Gets it very full on middle stump, he digs it towards cover
BANG! Back of a length ball outside off, he takes a step outside the line of leg stump, and cracks it through point and cover-point. The balls speeds off across the carpet.

Goes straight and over the ropes! What a shot! Nothing wrong with the ball really. Was on a length on the stumps. He extends his arms, a full swing of the arms and pummels him over mid-on and over the ropes
On a length just outside off, he squirts it off the outer half of the blade towards deep third.
And now the on-drive! Rachin putting on a show here. Was fuller on off stump, he presses forward, presenting the full face of the bat and drives past the bowler
TONKED! Back of a length ball just outside off. He stays on the front foot, transfers his weight and slams the pull over midwicket.
On a length on middle stump. He flicks it to the right of deep backward square leg for a run
Crunched but straight to cover. Was on a length outside off, he stays leg side of the ball, dances down and leans into the drive, but can't find the gap
Length ball on middle and leg, he shimmies down and works to deep backward square leg for a couple of runs
Edged and falls short of Sai Kishore. Good comeback from Umesh. Was a length ball shaping ever so slightly away from Rachin outside off. He pokes at it, gets a healthy edge that does not go to hand
THRASHED! Was on a length outside off and the width was key. He throws his hands and hammers it over point.
Picked up off his hips and dumped into the crowd! Was a back of a length ball and on Rachin's hips. He gets across and clips it with authority over deep backward square leg
Sprays the back of a length ball down leg, called a wide,
Aerial but safe. Was pushed fuller outside off, Rachin looks for a drive on the up, miscued but is lucky the ball does not go to hand at mid-off
On a length on off and middle, he pushes towards extra cover
Sharp back of a length ball outside off, he punches to backward point

Edged and put down! Oh, dear Sai Kishore it is, who puts down a simple enough chance. That could be a big moment in the game. Excellent ball from Omarzai. Gets the ball on a length outside off, drawing Gaikwad forward. The ball shapes away and catches the outside edge of Gaikwad's blade who was on the move. The catch was at a comfortable height for Sai Kishore, but he shells it
Keeps it on a length outside off, he plays with an open face of the bat but can't beat backward point
On a length with a hint of shape away from Gaikwad who watches closely and shoulders arms
Strays the length ball on middle and leg as Rachin gets across and works it to fine leg
Banged in short of a length outside off, he stands tall and works to the right of mid-on to get off the mark
Good length ball to start off just outside off. Gaikwad shimmies down and pushes to backward point
full ball just outside off stump. Tries to hit it over cover but misses. Titans finish on 143 for 8 and CSK win by 63 runs!
classic Umesh! In the arc, out of the park! Full ball around middle stump, and Umesh hammers this over wide long on with a golf-like swing!
good length ball on leg. Swipes across the line and mistimes to deep midwicket
wide yorker, is that inside the tram-lines? Yes, it is! Pinpoint
good length ball wider outside off. Slaps a shot past point to the fielder in the deep
good length ball outside off. Beaten by the pace as he misses the cut
good length ball just outside off. Cut to backward point, and intercepted by Ruturaj
low full toss outside off stump. Hammered over cover and that's free four runs for Spencer
good length ball on leg stump and he clobbers a flat-batted shot to wide long on
full toss around leg stump. Misses the flick. Ball rolls away to the off side for a single
full ball wider outside off stump. Tewatia shapes up to clobber it over long off but it doesn't have the power. Rachin stays on the long-off boundary line, and takes a simple catch
good length ball on middle, and bunted to midwicket's left for a single
full ball just outside off stump. Tries to go over the top with a straight shot but misses the connection altogether
short ball outside leg stump. Lets it go through and they take a wide run

full ball just outside leg stump. Tewatia tries to flick off his toes but misses. The ball is destined to go past Dhoni but he slides across the carpet with a dive and stops a few bye runs. This was 151kph!
back of a length ball just outside leg. Tewatia swivels and places a pull well behind square, past fine leg for four!
full ball on middle stump and flicked off his toes to deep square leg for a single
full ball on leg stump. Raises the front leg and flicks it towards deep square leg

full ball just outside leg stump. Tries to flick it leg side and misses, beaten by the pace (150.9kph). Pathirana appeals for lbw and the umpire takes his time before raising his finger. Tewatia reviews right away. The only question is, where has it pitched? Yes, the TV umpire activates the smart replay and first goes to ball-tracking which confirms what we thought. Pitching outside leg. The review is gone again.
length ball pitching outside leg and angling into his body. Tries to clip it leg side but misses. Hits his pad and the ball dribbles away to the off side
length ball around leg, and this is the cutter again.  Angling across and gently bunted for a single
good length ball on middle and angling towards off. Umesh offers minimal footwork and tries to guide it leg-side off his body. Misses, and through to Dhoni on the bounce
full ball outside off. Slower ball angling across the right-hander. Tries to hammer it over the off side but loses his shape and misses it altogether

that's...... gone! Good length ball on leg, and this is the cutter in fact. Ball scrambles Rashid as he clears the front leg and tries to club it over the leg side. Totally mistimed, and Rachin is in the action again at deep square leg
good length ball flat-batted to long on for a single

full ball around leg stump. Tries to flick off his pads, but is too slow to bring the bat down. Raps him on the leg and that's a big lbw appeal. Turned down as they scurry across for a run. Gaikwad reviews and the TV umpire uses the smart replay to ignore all other facts before checking ball-tracking. Now we know why, pitching outside leg stump, so no use wasting time checking for edges. CSK lose a review. We move

full and wide outside off stump. Tries the drive but misses, and this is just inside the tram-lines. The umpire gives it a wide. Dhoni consults with Gaikwad and reviews. TV umpire believes that's inside the line. Umpire changes his decision
back of a length ball on leg and angling towards off stump. Tewatia attempts a cut but the ball is too close to his body. Misses
good length ball on off. Angling into middle stump. Late glance to short third for a single

this time Rachin takes the catch! Redeems himself. Short and wide ball. Omarzai tries to slap it over backward point but ends up flat-batting a shot high up in the air. Rachin runs across from extra cover to cover and brings out the reverse-cup catching technique again...however, this time it sticks! Takes a tumble on the followthrough but sports a smile as the ball is firmly in his grasp
knee-high full toss on leg. Makes room and flicks off his pads. Gets it past deep square leg for four!
short ball on middle, and surprises Tewatia first up. He does well to sway away from the ball's line, letting it go

full ball on off stump. Sudharsan shows aggression by trying to lift it over long on, but checks it in the last moment. Doesn't have the distance to clear Rizvi at long on and he takes a simple catch near the boundary line.
good length ball outside leg stump. Sudharsan charges down the track to pull but misses
good length ball angling across and Sai can't connect with an inside out shot

dropped by Rachin! Good length ball on a fifth-stump line. Sudharsan looks to lift it over cover but slices the shot. Ball goes high up and Rachin runs backwards from extra cover and tries a reverse-cup catching technique. But it hits his finger and that goes down
good length ball on middle. Tries to nudge it leg side but ends up fending the shot back to the bowler
good length ball, fifth-stump line. Drags a sloggy shot to deep midwicket

good length ball on an off-stump line. Opens the bat's face and bunts it to Jadeja at point. Risky run given who the fielder is, but they complete it without Jadeja trying to throw the stumps down. Time out
full ball just outside off. Pace off there. Sudharsan muscles a shot down to long off but only one run for that
back of a length ball angling into his body. Cramps him up but he manages to knock a shot to the leg side. Takes off for a single
short ball on a fifth-stump line. Really bent his back there. Too high, and wide given as the batter offers no shot
slower ball, back of a good length on leg. Swipes a pull across the line to the deep

full ball on middle. Makes a bit of room and drives to mid off. They call for a single and Ruturaj moves to his left from cover to pick up and throw at the stumps. Breaks the stumps but the batter was in
full ball just outside off. Crunches a compact drive down the V, but stopped at mid off
full ball, slower through the air. Lands on middle and leg. Flicked to wide long on for a couple more to the total
flatter, good length on leg. Hurries onto Sudharsan. Mistimes a grounded pull to deep square leg

good length ball on middle. Goes deep in his crease. Ball turns in and he knocks it away to deep midwicket with soft hands. The gentleness of the shot allows them to take two, even if it looked dangerous
fullish ball around off stump. Gently knocks it with the turn to backward point
length ball on a fourth-stump line. Stays in his crease and cuts with the turn to point
full ball just outside off. Bit of turn away. Driven along the ground to cover
back of a good length just outside off. Flays a shot away from his body, sending it down to deep third

Rahane with an athletic effort to take a stunning catch! Deshpande searches for the yorker on leg stump. Miller clears his front leg and tries to dropkick a flick through midwicket, but Rahane attacks the ball from cow corner, running in, and then dives forward to take a low catch! Stunning catch
overpitched ball on off and he crunches a shot down the ground. But straight to mid off

short of good length ball on leg and he pulls along the ground to deep midwicket. Miller calls for a second but it is a risky call. Fielder from the deep (Rahane) throws it in, but it gets to Dhoni on the bounce, allowing Miller to dive and finish the two.
good length ball on leg and angling across to off stump. Checks a cut shot towards point
good length ball around leg stump. Clipped off his pads to short fine leg for a single
slower ball, full just outside off. Sudharsan wants to work it towards mid on but a leading edge sends it towards cover instead. They scurry across for a single
good length ball, quite wide outside off. Tries to slap it square but it takes a bottom edge to the leg side
ramped over Dhoni! Back of a length ball just outside off. Miller hangs back before getting the bat towards the ball and helps it on its way over the keeper
short of length ball on middle. Bunted off his body towards mid on's left for a single
works it off his pads to the leg side for a single

good length ball just outside off. Sudharsan lets the ball get to him and plays a very late glance with the bat's face opened. Hits it past third slip's left, and also beats deep third! Beautiful touch to place it with that teasing pace
good length ball angling across and he drives away from his body to deep extra cover
placedddd! Short ball on leg stump. He  swivels and pulls, and breaks his wrists while playing it, ensuring the shot goes behind square, beating the deep square leg fielder
length ball around leg stump and punched towards mid-on for a single
in the air but falls short of Tushar running in from cow corner. Short ball on leg and Sudharsan mistimed a pull. Ball was in the air for a while, and despite Tushar's sprint he cannot get there
full ball, but very wide outside off stump. Left alone and they collect a wide run
good length ball ouside off. Slaps a cut towards deep point for a single
full ball on middle. Miller comes down the track, stays leg-side of the ball, and clatters a drive between mid off and cover!
full ball on middle, pace off. Miller throws his bat at this and mistimes a shot to long on. Time out
length ball angling across, but too wide across Miller. Wide given
short ball, tucks Miller up as he spots the length late. Awkwardly fends after riding the bounce, bunting a shot to the leg side
full ball, bit wider outside off stump. Tries the drive but misses the connection. Through to MS
through the slip cordon! But there's nobody standing there. Good length ball just outside off stump. Miller tries to punch a drive straight back but it takes the outside edge down to deep third
short ball around leg and he semi-ducks. Dhoni sticks both hands up to see if the ball sticks, but it grazes his glove and goes behind. They pinch a run in addition to the leg-side wide
back of a length ball on leg. Cramps him slightly but he manages to work it off his waist to the leg side
good length ball on leg and he comfortably works it off his pads to the leg side. Gets a couple more
full ball just outside off. Throws his hands at it, and drives along the ground to deep extra cover
fullish ball just outside off. A punchy shot to mid off for a single while the fielder runs in and tries an under-arm throw
good length ball on off stump and fended towards the non-striker. Mitchell moves to his right to attempt an interception, but misses. Nonetheless that dissuades the batters from taking one

vintage Dhoni! Dives to his right and he gets both hands to it! Full ball on a fourth-stump line. Shankar tries to drive straight but the ball takes the edge, and Dhoni pounces onto it in legendary fashion
full ball around off. A cutter, actually. He comes down the track and guides a shot through to wide long on for a couple
fullish ball outside off. Slaps it behind square towards point for a single
fullish ball on middle. Stays in his crease and clips to square leg for a single
full ball just outside off. Turning away a bit and tapped gently to cover with the turn
flatter. Length ball on middle stump. Hangs back and pulls to deep midwicket along the grass
length ball on off. Batter moves to the off side slightly, and then clips it to the vacant square-leg area. Dhoni gives the ball a chase and the crowd gives out a big roar
good length ball on middle, and flicked to square leg for a single
here's Jadeja, and he starts off with a length ball around off. Sudharsan hangs back and plays a very, very, very late cut, getting it past Dhoni's legs for four
good length ball on a fourth-stump line and he fends it back to Deshpande. End of the powerplay at 43/2
fullish ball on middle and off. Stays in his crease and clips it to the leg side for a single
good length ball outside off. Cut towards the left of backward point
fuller. Shankar prods forward and fends it back to the bowler
Shankar feels at home, I think! Short ball around off. True bounce onto Shankar. And he launches a pull in front of square, swiveling before depositing it in the stands
good length ball just outside off. Skiddy ball and struck with the full face of the bat towards the bowler
back of a good length ball just outside off stump. Rides the bounce and taps to the off side
short ball. Shankar considers playing a shot but eventually sways away from the ball's line. That was a snorter
good length ball just outside off stump. Wants to play straight, but mistimed to midwicket

straight to deep square leg! The fielder was present there for the short ball, and the ploy has paid off. Short of good length ball coming into Saha. He bravely goes for the pull. Drags the shot behind square, and it doesn't have the height to go all the way.

raps him on the grille! Short ball just outside off and rises onto Saha. He loses sight on the ball while trying to pull, and the ball hits him on the helmet. Physio doing a check, and Saha has a smile
back of a length on leg. Sudharsan is tall and comfortably pulls it over the vacant square leg region. Deep square leg cleans up
short ball outside leg and shaping further down leg stump. Sudharsan, for his part, attempted the pull on this wayward ball
good length ball on middle, and he punches to mid off and calls quickly for the single. Slower ball this one, only 121kph
good length ball on middle and off stump. Sudharsan plays a compact punch towards cover
fullish ball outside off and he thrashes a mistimed drive to mid off. Takes off for a single but the fielder at mid-off runs in, swoops low, and has a shy at the stumps with Saha scurrying across.
back of a length ball around off. Saha tries to pull along the ground through midwicket but drags the shot onto his pads
good length ball on leg and he clips this off his waist to backward square leg
drives this fullish ball outside off, and gets it in the gap near mid off but intercepted
short ball on leg stump, and he half-ducks before letting the ball go

celebrappeal from Chahar, and given by the umpire lbw! Gill reviews. This is a good length ball on off and Gill looks to play a check-pull in front of square, but the ball stays marginally low and hits him on the back leg. Will height save Gill? Tense GT fans in the crowd.... and that's three reds! The Titans captain is gone for a five-ball eight
good length ball, fifth-stump line. Punches off the back foot with the bat's open face, but beats the diving point fielder
full ball going down the leg side

great swivel from Saha, before pulling through to deep square leg, beating the fine-leg fielder. Back of a good length ball on middle. Saha got in position early, and it is a flat shot. One-bounce four

loses one hand, but manages to get it over mid off! Fullish ball outside off, and it is a knuckle ball. Saha goes through the shot, and even though he's deceived, he manages to complete the followthrough behind the shot even if he only uses one hand.
slower ball, full just outside off stump. Gently tapped to cover point's left for a single
good length ball just outside off stump. Angling across as he tries to drive over cover. No connection

edged, and flies through between Dhoni and first slip! Full ball outside off. Saha throws his bat at it, and it takes a thick edge. The ball is gone before either Dhoni or the first-slip fielder could react. To be fair, even if they dived, it would've been a tough chance
fullish ball on middle and off. Bunted towards the off side and they take off for a quick single
good length ball on off and he fends it towards short cover
full ball outside off. Drives, playing away from his body, and the ball takes an inside edge before going past the stumps to square leg
full ball on middle, bit of swing into Saha, but he prods forward and plays a glorious straight drive past Gill. Four to start the over

beautiful! Good length ball on off. Gill dances down the track, stays on the leg-side of the ball, and hits it through the line, over the bowler's head! Camera pans to the GT dug out where you can see Williamson and Shankar looking at each other and looking mighty impressed at that shot. An excellent Chahar over ends up being an average one
good length ball just outside off. Hangs the bat out, opens its face, and guides it to deep third for the first runs of the chase
good length ball on a fifth-stump line. Bit of shape into Saha, and he taps it off the back foot to the off side
good length ball outside off. Rides the bounce and cuts, but can't beat point
length ball on middle. Skidding into leg. Tucks Saha up, and fended to the off side
yorker length, well almost. Around off stump, and dug back towards the bowler
